claim: AWS Direct Connect is a networking service that provides an alternative to the internet for connecting to AWS: data that would have crossed the internet is delivered through a private network connection between your facilities and AWS.
question: What is AWS Direct Connect?

values.display: an alternative to using the internet to connect to AWS
values.spoken: a private network connection to AWS instead of the internet

evidence.quote: AWS Direct Connect is a networking service that provides an alternative to using the internet to connect to AWS. Using AWS Direct Connect, data that would have previously been transported over the internet is delivered through a private network connection between your facilities and AWS.

note: FAQ question: 'What is AWS Direct Connect?' (item 1).

claim: In many circumstances, private network connections can reduce costs, increase bandwidth, and provide a more consistent network experience than internet-based connections.
question: What benefits can private Direct Connect network connections have over internet-based connections?

values.display: a more consistent network experience
values.spoken: lower cost, more bandwidth and a more consistent experience

evidence.quote: In many circumstances, private network connections can reduce costs, increase bandwidth, and provide a more consistent network experience than internet-based connections.

note: FAQ question: 'What is AWS Direct Connect?' (item 1).

claim: A dedicated connection is made through a 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, or 400 Gbps Ethernet port dedicated to a single customer, while hosted connections are sourced from an AWS Direct Connect Partner that has a network link between itself and AWS.
question: What is the difference between dedicated and hosted Direct Connect connections?

values.display: an Ethernet port dedicated to a single customer
values.spoken: a dedicated connection is a port reserved for one customer

values.display: sourced from a AWS Direct Connect Partner
values.spoken: a hosted connection comes from a Direct Connect Partner

evidence.quote: A dedicated connection is made through a 1 Gbps, 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, or 400 Gbps Ethernet port dedicated to a single customer. Hosted connections are sourced from a AWS Direct Connect Partner that has a network link between themselves and AWS.

note: FAQ question: 'What is the difference between dedicated and hosted connections?' (item 3).

claim: If your network is not present at an AWS Direct Connect location, AWS Direct Connect Partners can help you extend your existing data center or office network to a Direct Connect location.
question: Can you use AWS Direct Connect if your network is not present at an AWS Direct Connect location?

values.display: Partners can help you extend your preexisting data center or office network
values.spoken: a Direct Connect Partner can extend your network to the location

qualifiers.condition: your network is not present at a Direct Connect location

evidence.quote: AWS Direct Connect Partners can help you extend your preexisting data center or office network to a AWS Direct Connect location.

note: FAQ question: 'Can I use AWS Direct Connect if my network is not present at an AWS Direct Connect location?' (item 5).

claim: With an AWS Direct Connect gateway you can access any AWS Region from any AWS Direct Connect location, excluding China.
question: Which Regions can you reach from a Direct Connect location when you use a Direct Connect gateway?

values.display: any AWS Region from any AWS Direct Connect Location
values.spoken: any Region from any location, except China

evidence.quote: With AWS Direct Connect Gateway, you can access any AWS Region from any AWS Direct Connect Location (excluding China).

note: FAQ question: 'Can I use AWS Direct Connect if my network is not present at an AWS Direct Connect location?' (item 5).

claim: AWS does not act as your first-mile or last-mile provider: you connect your on-premises locations to a Direct Connect location through local service providers or an AWS Direct Connect Delivery Partner.
question: Does AWS act as your first-mile or last-mile provider to connect on-premises locations to AWS?

values.display: work with an AWS Direct Connect Delivery Partner
values.spoken: AWS is not the first or last mile; use local providers or a Delivery Partner

evidence.quote: No, you need to make connections between the local service providers used at your on-premises locations, or work with an AWS Direct Connect Delivery Partner, to connect to AWS Direct Connect locations.

note: FAQ question: 'Does AWS act as my "first mile" or "last mile" provider to connect my on-premises locations to AWS?' (item 6).

claim: An AWS Direct Connect gateway is a grouping of virtual private gateways and private virtual interfaces; it is a globally available resource that you can create in any Region and access from all other Regions.
question: What is an AWS Direct Connect gateway?

values.display: a globally available resource
values.spoken: a Direct Connect gateway is global

evidence.quote: An AWS Direct Connect gateway is a grouping of virtual private gateways (VGWs) and private virtual interfaces (VIFs). An AWS Direct Connect gateway is a globally available resource. You can create the AWS Direct Connect gateway in any Region and access it from all other Regions.

note: FAQ question: 'What is an AWS Direct Connect gateway?' (item 8).

claim: A virtual interface (VIF) is necessary to access AWS services and is either public or private: a public virtual interface enables access to public services such as Amazon S3, and a private virtual interface enables access to your VPC.
question: What is a virtual interface (VIF), and what do public and private VIFs reach?

values.display: A public virtual interface enables access to public services
A private virtual interface enables access to your VPC

evidence.quote: A virtual interface (VIF) is necessary to access AWS services, and is either public or private. A public virtual interface enables access to public services, such as Amazon S3. A private virtual interface enables access to your VPC.

note: FAQ question: 'What is a virtual interface (VIF)?' (item 9). The FAQ answer names only public and private here; the transit VIF is defined in item 17.

claim: A link aggregation group (LAG) is a logical interface that uses LACP to aggregate multiple dedicated connections at a single Direct Connect endpoint so you can treat them as one managed connection; the LAG configuration applies to all connections in the group.
question: What is a link aggregation group (LAG)?

values.display: a logical interface that uses the link aggregation control protocol
values.spoken: a LAG bundles several dedicated connections into one

qualifiers.condition: dedicated connections at a single Direct Connect endpoint

evidence.quote: A link aggregation group (LAG) is a logical interface that uses the link aggregation control protocol (LACP) to aggregate multiple dedicated connections at a single AWS Direct Connect endpoint, allowing you to treat them as a single, managed connection. LAGs streamline configuration because the LAG configuration applies to all connections in the group.

note: FAQ question: 'What is a link aggregation group (LAG)?' (item 11).

claim: The AWS Direct Connect Resiliency Toolkit provides a connection wizard that helps you choose between multiple resiliency models.
question: What is the AWS Direct Connect Resiliency Toolkit?

values.display: a connection wizard
values.spoken: a wizard that helps you pick a resiliency model and order the connections

evidence.quote: The AWS Direct Connect Resiliency Toolkit provides a connection wizard that helps you choose between multiple resiliency models.

note: FAQ question: 'What is the AWS Direct Connect Resiliency Toolkit?' (item 12).

claim: A transit virtual interface is a type of virtual interface you can create on any AWS Direct Connect connection, and it can only be attached to an AWS Direct Connect gateway.
question: What can a transit virtual interface be attached to?

values.display: can only be attached to an AWS Direct Connect gateway
values.spoken: a transit VIF attaches only to a Direct Connect gateway

evidence.quote: A transit virtual interface is a type of virtual interface you can create on any AWS Direct Connect connection. A transit virtual interface can only be attached to an AWS Direct Connect gateway.

note: FAQ question: 'What is a transit virtual interface?' (item 17).

claim: You can associate up to six transit gateways with an AWS Direct Connect gateway as long as the IP CIDR blocks announced from the transit gateways do not overlap.
question: How many AWS Transit Gateways can you associate with one AWS Direct Connect gateway?

values.display: up to six Transit Gateway

qualifiers.condition: the IP CIDR blocks announced from the transit gateways do not overlap

evidence.quote: You can associate up to six Transit Gateway to an AWS Direct Connect gateway as long as the IP CIDR blocks announced from your Transit Gateways do not overlap.

note: FAQ question: 'Can I associate more than one AWS Transit Gateway with an AWS Direct Connect gateway?' (item 119). Compare with the quotas page value; transit-gateway-quota-gateways-per-dx-gateway exists in the canon.

claim: MACsec (802.1AE) is an IEEE standard that provides data confidentiality, data integrity, and data origin authenticity; on MACsec-capable connections it encrypts data from your on-premises network or collocated device to the Direct Connect point of presence.
question: What is MACsec and what does it encrypt on Direct Connect?

values.display: to your chosen AWS Direct Connect point of presence
values.spoken: MACsec encrypts between your device and the Direct Connect location

qualifiers.scope: from the on-premises network or collocated device to the Direct Connect point of presence

evidence.quote: 802.1AE MAC Security (MACsec) is an IEEE standard that provides data confidentiality, data integrity, and data origin authenticity. You can use AWS Direct Connect connections that support MACsec to encrypt your data from your on-premises network or collocated device to your chosen AWS Direct Connect point of presence.

note: FAQ question: 'What is MACsec?' (item 19).

claim: MACsec is supported on 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps dedicated connections at selected points of presence; it is not supported on 1 Gbps dedicated connections or any hosted connections.
question: Which types of AWS Direct Connect connections support MACsec?

values.display: 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps dedicated
not supported on 1 Gbps dedicated connections or any hosted connections

qualifiers.condition: selected points of presence; dedicated connection must be transparent to Layer 2 traffic and the terminating device must support MACsec

evidence.quote: MACsec is supported on 10 Gbps, 100 Gbps, and 400 Gbps dedicated AWS Direct Connect connections at selected points of presence. For MACsec to work, your dedicated connection must be transparent to Layer 2 traffic and the device terminating the Layer 2 adjacency must support MACsec. If you are using a last-mile connectivity partner, check that your last-mile connection can support MACsec. MACsec is not supported on 1 Gbps dedicated connections or any hosted connections.

note: FAQ question: 'Which type of AWS Direct Connect connections support MACsec?' (item 177).

claim: MACsec is not intended as a replacement for any specific encryption technology; AWS says to keep using the encryption you already use, for defense in depth, and to add MACsec as an extra option.
question: Does MACsec replace the other encryption technologies you use in your network?

values.display: MACsec is not intended as a replacement
values.spoken: MACsec adds to your other encryption, it does not replace it

evidence.quote: MACsec is not intended as a replacement for any specific encryption technology. For simplicity, and for defense in depth, you should continue to use any encryption technologies that you already use. We offer MACsec as an encryption option you can integrate into your network in addition to other encryption technologies you currently use.

note: FAQ question: 'Does MACsec replace other encryption technologies I currently use in my network?' (item 176).

claim: To use MACsec you need a MACsec-capable device on your end of the Ethernet connection to an AWS Direct Connect location.
question: Do you need special hardware to use MACsec with Direct Connect?

values.display: You will need a MACsec-capable device
values.spoken: you need a MACsec-capable device on your side

evidence.quote: Yes. You will need a MACsec-capable device on your end of the Ethernet connection to an AWS Direct Connect location.

note: FAQ question: 'Do I need any special hardware to use MACsec?' (item 178).

claim: There is no additional charge for MACsec.
question: Is there an additional charge for MACsec on Direct Connect?

values.display: no additional charge for MACsec

evidence.quote: No, there is no additional charge for MACsec.

note: FAQ question: 'Is there an additional charge for MACsec?' (item 185).

claim: For 100 Gbps and 400 Gbps connections AWS supports the GCM-AES-XPN-256 cipher suite; for 10Gbps connections it supports GCM-AES-256 and GCM-AES-XPN-256.
question: Which MACsec cipher suites does Direct Connect support?

values.display: GCM-AES-XPN-256
GCM-AES-256

qualifiers.condition: 100 Gbps and 400 Gbps: GCM-AES-XPN-256 only; 10Gbps: GCM-AES-256 and GCM-AES-XPN-256

evidence.quote: For 100 Gbps and 400 Gbps connections we support the GCM-AES-XPN-256 cipher suite. For 10Gbps connections we support GCM-AES-256 and GCM-AES-XPN-256.

note: FAQ question: 'Which MACsec cipher suites do you support?' (item 180).

claim: When AWS Direct Connect SiteLink is enabled at two or more Direct Connect locations, you can send data between those locations bypassing AWS Regions; SiteLink works with both hosted and dedicated connections.
question: What is AWS Direct Connect SiteLink?

values.display: bypassing AWS Regions
values.spoken: SiteLink sends data between locations without going through a Region

qualifiers.condition: enabled at two or more Direct Connect locations

evidence.quote: When the AWS Direct Connect SiteLink feature is enabled at two or more AWS Direct Connect locations, you can send data between those locations, bypassing AWS Regions. AWS Direct Connect SiteLink works with both hosted and dedicated connections.

note: FAQ question: 'What is AWS Direct Connect SiteLink?' (item 20).

claim: To use Direct Connect SiteLink you must connect SiteLink-enabled virtual interfaces to an AWS Direct Connect gateway, and the VIF type can be private or transit.
question: Does AWS Direct Connect SiteLink require a Direct Connect gateway, and which VIF types?

values.display: you must connect AWS Direct Connect SiteLink-enabled virtual interfaces
values.spoken: SiteLink VIFs attach to a Direct Connect gateway

evidence.quote: Yes. To use AWS Direct Connect SiteLink, you must connect AWS Direct Connect SiteLink-enabled virtual interfaces (VIFs) to an AWS Direct Connect gateway. The VIF type can be private or transit.

note: FAQ question: 'Does AWS Direct Connect SiteLink require an AWS Direct Connect gateway connection?' (item 34).

claim: AWS Direct Connect SiteLink requires BGP.
question: Does AWS Direct Connect SiteLink require BGP?

values.display: SiteLink requires BGP

evidence.quote: Yes. AWS Direct Connect SiteLink requires BGP.

note: FAQ question: 'Does AWS Direct Connect SiteLink require BGP?' (item 40).

claim: Cloud WAN can create and manage networks of VPCs across multiple Regions, while Direct Connect SiteLink connects Direct Connect locations together, bypassing AWS Regions to improve performance.
question: When should you use AWS Direct Connect SiteLink and when AWS Cloud WAN?

values.display: networks of VPCs across multiple Regions
connects DX locations together, bypassing AWS Regions

evidence.quote: Cloud WAN can create and manage networks of VPCs across multiple Regions. AWS Direct Connect SiteLink, on the other hand, connects DX locations together, bypassing AWS Regions to improve performance.

note: FAQ question: 'When should I use AWS Direct Connect SiteLink and when should I use AWS Cloud WAN?' (item 45).
